svg.title: Acoustic energy and pulse-duration variables
svg.desc: Acoustic energy Esh is the declared eta_sh fraction of absorbed energy. Pressure pprime is recorded a distance r from the source, over pulse width tau_sh, in carrier impedance rho c.
